'''Fluggrians''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] [[Species/Legends|species]] with high foreheads that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ploo IV/Legends|Ploo IV]].

==Biology and appearance==
Fluggrians were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Kids9 (1999)" /> They possessed two [[Limb/Legends|arms]] and two legs,<ref name="SWCTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> and were squat and [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned.<ref name="TCSWE" /> Their heads, which featured high foreheads,<ref name="TCSWE" /> were shaped similarly to a [[Snail/Legends|snail]]. The four<ref name="Kids9 (1999)" /> knobby protrusions<ref name="TCSWE" /> on their foreheads were neural bundles that helped the species process sensory input at exceedingly high speeds. Below the forehead were their [[Fish/Legends|fish]]-shaped lips that covered their big [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. Gills were arranged as bands on the sides of their neck.<ref name="Kids9 (1999)" />

==Society and culture==
[[File:ElanMak-SWREP14.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Kam Nale as "Elan Mak" during the [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]]]]
Native to a marshy [[Planet/Legends|planet]] called [[Ploo IV/Legends|Ploo IV]], the Fluggrians lived on floating cities which connected via thick underwater transit tubes. Plagued by a high crime rate, the planet's inhabitants were highly suspicious as a society and were highly intolerant of the [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] race which was native to the neighboring world [[Ploo II/Legends|Ploo II]].

==History==
A species native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ploo IV/Legends|Ploo IV]], the Fluggrians established floating cities on their world before being discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Subterra Period]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Developing space travel, the Fluggrians came into contact with the [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] species which inhabited the planet [[Ploo II/Legends|Ploo II]], a world within the same [[Ploo system/Legends|star system]]. Highly intolerant of each other, the Fluggrians constantly warred with the Glymphids and formed a cultural stigma against each other.

Controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the species' homeworld was invaded by the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]] during the species' [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Fluggrians in the galaxy==
A space-faring species, the Fluggrians were often plagued with a cultural tendency towards organized crime and underhanded dealings. During the final decades of the Galactic Republic, the Fluggrian [[Kam Nale]] posed as a prominent [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] using the alias ''Elan Mak''. The son of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Borzu Nale]], the younger Nale entered the race to track the Glymphid [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]], the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] responsible for the death of his father. Piloting a [[KRT 410C/Legends|KRT 410C]] in his first [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]], Nale finished fifth despite his inexperience and decided to make a career out of the sport.<ref name="TCSWE" />
